item.title: Brayden McNabb: Banned three games
item.description:
McNabb was suspended three games Monday by the NHL Department of Player Safety for cross-checking Quinton Byfield, per Jesse Granger of The Athletic.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Alex Lyon: Hurt in Thursday's game
item.description: Lyon sustained an upper-body injury in the first period of Thursday's preseason game against the Red Wings, Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News reports.

item.title: Ivan Ryabkin: Earns look on second line
item.description: Ryabkin skated on the second line at Wednesday's practice, according to the team's beat writers.

item.title: Elias Pettersson: Day-to-day with lower-body injury
item.description: Pettersson is day-to-day with a lower-body injury, Canucks head coach Adam Foote said Wednesday.

item.title: Sebastian Aho: Leaves practice early
item.description: Aho left the Hurricanes' practice early Wednesday with an apparent injury, per Cory Lavalette of The North State Journal.
